summary: Taiwan PCB Makers Race to Secure Second-Source Materials as AI Demand Reshapes Laminate Supply Chain Source: atlaspcb.com | Date: 2026-05-11 Taiwan's PCB supply chain is aggressively diversifying CCL and laminate suppliers as AI server demand drives the global copper-clad laminate market into allocation mode. With the market projected to reach $95.8 billion in 2026, material security has become a strategic priority. ## Material Constraints AI server motherboards require ultra-low-loss laminates with Dk values below 3.3 and Df under 0.002 at 10 GHz.

claims.text: Taiwan PCB Makers Race to Secure Second-Source Materials as AI Demand Reshapes Laminate Supply Chain Source: atlaspcb.com | Date: 2026-05-11 Taiwan's PCB supply chain is aggressively diversifying CCL and laminate suppliers as AI server demand drives the global copper-clad laminate market into allocation mode.
With the market projected to reach $95.8 billion in 2026, material security has become a strategic priority.
## Material Constraints AI server motherboards require ultra-low-loss laminates with Dk values below 3.3 and Df under 0.002 at 10 GHz.
This has created severe allocation constraints at major CCL manufacturers including Mitsubishi Gas Chemical (MGC), Panasonic, and AGC.
